components.css: .ds-card{background:white;color:var(--ink,#183b32);border:1px solid var(--line,#d8ddd2);border-radius:14px;padding:20px;font:13px Arial,sans-serif}.ds-card h3{font:400 25px Georgia,serif;margin:10px 0}.ds-card p{color:var(--muted,#526259);line-height:1.6}.ds-card a{color:inherit;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-card a:hover{text-decoration-thickness:2px}.ds-card a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--rust,#a4462e);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: A travel journal applied to a working hotel reservation application. Warm paper surrounds forest-green controls and local destination typography. The catalog leads to an availability form and explicit demo reservation; decorative material does not imply that fictional properties are real.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial serif headlines with clear sans-serif controls.
Quiet surfaces separated by thin borders.
Local destination artwork and visible demo labels.
dos: Do preserve persistent form labels, visible focus, and explicit loading/error states.
Do identify fictional stays and simulated payments.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences; content must remain visible without animation.
donts: Don't present destination artwork as a hotel photograph.
Don't display a previous quote as current after its input changes.
